name: GPT-SoVITS
description: Zero-shot and few-shot voice cloning / TTS toolkit (RVC-Boss/GPT-SoVITS) combining a GPT text-to-semantic model with a SoVITS acoustic model. Ships a custom FastAPI/uvicorn HTTP inference server (api.py legacy, api_v2.py current) on port 9880 and a suite of Gradio WebUIs (training 9874, inference 9872, UVR5 vocal separation 9873, subfix subtitle editor 9871). Clones a target voice from a single short reference clip. No built-in authentication on the API server or any of the WebUIs.
auth_notes: Neither the api_v2.py FastAPI server (port 9880) nor the Gradio WebUIs (9872/9874/9873/9871) implement any authentication by default. Gradio's launch() is called without auth= in the upstream repo, so the inference and training UIs are fully open when bound to 0.0.0.0. The HTTP API exposes /tts, /control (restart/exit), /set_gpt_weights and /set_sovits_weights with no token check. Operators are expected to firewall the ports or place a reverse proxy in front; hobbyist and RunPod/Vast.ai deployments frequently expose 9880 and 9872 directly. Reference-audio path parameters accept server-local filesystem paths, giving an unauthenticated caller a file-oriented primitive on the API server.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Default GPT-SoVITS API port; FastAPI /docs body renders the /tts route. Broad — pair with strict tier to strip generic FastAPI TTS wrappers
Gradio inference/training WebUI (9872/9874) with the project name rendered in the app title/markdown header; disambiguates from generic RVC/Applio Gradio apps
The /set_gpt_weights and /set_sovits_weights routes rendered in the FastAPI Swagger body are unique to GPT-SoVITS api_v2.py; near-zero false positives
Gradio WebUI title plus the reference-audio upload label; identifies the interactive cloning UI specifically (9872/9874)
Version marker (v1/v2/v2Pro/v3/v4) rendered in the WebUI header for version-targeted enumeration; adjust the version token per campaign

known_vulns: No built-in auth on api_v2.py (9880) — unauthenticated GET/POST /tts synthesizes arbitrary speech in any cloned voice from any caller
GET /control endpoint accepts command=exit and command=restart with no auth — unauthenticated DoS / process control on the API server
Reference-audio and weights parameters accept server-local filesystem paths (ref_audio_path, gpt_weights_path) — path-controlled read/load primitive for an unauthenticated caller
Gradio WebUIs (9872/9874) launched without auth= and often with share=True — public gradio.live tunnels bypass any host firewall

Gradio framework CVE-2023-51449 (path traversal in /file, Gradio <4.11.0) and CVE-2024-1561 (arbitrary local file read via /component_server, Gradio 4.3-4.12) apply to the bundled Gradio UIs — leak /proc/self/environ and model/config files
Gradio SSRF CVE-2024-4325 / CVE-2024-47167 (/queue/join save_url_to_cache) reachable on the WebUI when URL-input components are present
FastAPI /docs and /openapi.json enabled by default — full schema disclosure aids automated enumeration
No rate limiting — unbounded GPU compute exhaustion (voice synthesis at operator cost)
risk_notes: This platform's core function is non-consensual voice cloning: a single reference clip fed to an open /tts endpoint yields arbitrary speech in a real person's voice, enabling biometric-identity theft, vishing, fraud, and fabricated-audio disinformation at scale and at the operator's GPU cost. (1) Identity theft / fraud enablement — an unauth 9880 endpoint is a turnkey impersonation service; combined with the /set_*_weights routes an attacker can hot-swap in any uploaded voice model. (2) Reference/training-audio exposure — reference clips and fine-tuned .ckpt/.pth voice models on disk (and reachable via path-controlled parameters or Gradio file-read CVEs) are the labeled voice datasets themselves; harvesting them clones the operator's and third parties' voices offline. (3) Compute theft — open GPU synthesis is automatable with any HTTP client. (4) Gradio file-read chain — CVE-2023-51449 / CVE-2024-1561 on the bundled WebUI leak /proc/self/environ (HF tokens, API keys) and arbitrary host files. (5) Process control — GET /control?command=exit is unauthenticated denial of service. (6) Disinformation — synthesized audio of public figures / executives seeds social-engineering and market-manipulation campaigns.
deployment_notes: Docker- and conda-based on CUDA GPU hosts; the official image and one-click Windows package are the common install paths. GPU-as-a-service (RunPod, Vast.ai, AutoDL — heavy zh-CN user base) deployments frequently expose 9880 (API) and 9872/9874 (Gradio UIs) directly. HuggingFace Spaces demos (kevinwang676/GPT-SoVITS-* and forks) are publicly indexed with no auth. api_v2.py is the current server (richer schema, /tts + /control + /set_*_weights); api.py is the legacy server (root POST + /change_refer + /control). WebUI port map: 9874 training, 9873 UVR5, 9872 inference, 9871 subfix, 9880 HTTP API. Ports are configurable in config.py / go-webui launch scripts, so shadow-port discovery matters. Many operators run the whole stack bound to 0.0.0.0 behind only a cloud security group.
